meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: Claude 会为你的项目添加 Matrix 聊天渠道：复制并安装适配器，构建和测试通过后，引导你配置一个独立的机器人账号，使你可以通过 Matrix 群聊或私聊和机器人对话。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 Matrix”“接入 Matrix 渠道”等请求，或表示想让机器人通过 Matrix 聊天时，此技能会被触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 渠道加进项目里。
say.note: 开始添加渠道支持的步骤。

say.text: 给机器人加上 Matrix 聊天支持。
say.note: 需要你提供机器人账号信息。

say.text: 我要让机器人能通过 Matrix 收发消息。
say.note: Claude 会带你完成接入配置。

howto.what_en: Claude adds Matrix as a chat channel for your project: it copies and installs the adapter, runs the build and tests, then walks you through setting up a dedicated bot account so people can message the bot from Matrix rooms or DMs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "add Matrix" or "integrate the Matrix channel", or when you want the bot to chat over Matrix.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel to my project.
Give the bot Matrix chat support.
say_en.note: You'll be asked for bot account details.

say_en.text: I want the bot to chat via Matrix.
